title.description: Short feature name for labels (e.g. "Chat protection").

crowd.description: Background chat (short reactions from made-up viewers, irregular like real typing). On by default; false turns it off.

every.description: Average gap between background lines in ms (default 1700).

lines.description: Your own reactions instead of the built-in ones.

director.description: auto (default): the camera follows the action. off: the picture stays still.

look.description: Art direction: studio, site (the website's Live First design), paper (print), signal (kinetic type), broadcast (cinematic UI), night (black, one accent, technical labels).

oneOf.description: Full-screen brand card (logo, name, a short line).

id.description: Name this beat so others can target it or time from it.

after.description: Make "+N" count from the END of this beat instead of the previous one.

with.description: Make "+N" count from the START of this beat (run alongside it).

dur.description: Length in ms (each block has a default).

sfx.description: Sound effect when this beat starts.

at.description: Start: absolute ms (number) or "+N" = N ms after the previous beat ends. Default "+0".
